stem: When light rays fall on a plane mirror and bounce back into the same medium, this phenomenon is called:
explanation: Reflection is the bouncing back of light from a surface into the same medium, following the law that the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

subject: Science
stem: When you stand in front of a plane (flat) mirror, your image appears to be the same size as you, upright, and located as far behind the mirror as you are in front of it, but with left and right reversed. This left-right reversal is called:
explanation: A plane mirror produces a virtual, erect, same-size image with lateral inversion (left appears right and vice versa) — which is why text appears reversed when held up to a mirror.
